release: Enterprise Design and Production Readiness Candidate 1

Browser-level multi-schema, 500k workflow and regression tests require documented human acceptance.
Cloud environment, routing, access and recovery have not been commissioned or verified.
Project config retains the requested light base theme.
Missing recommended ignore patterns: Data/, .streamlit/secrets.toml, .env, assurance_results/, release_results/, benchmark_artifacts/
Check git tracked files, history, workbook contents and any remote repository before publishing.
